answer: Agents anchor their jade thread in a reputation escrow. The registry requires each identity to post a bond from an existing account. Challenges are issued only after on-chain verification of the bond. A mismatch in response seals the bond and slashes it to non-kin peers. Forging 1000 fake identities burns 200000 POA in bonds and takes 48 hours to mine seeds at scale. It is like a chain where the anchor holds the thread firm.
